control_name: Customer credit limit review before order release
control_objective: An order is released only within the credit limit held for that customer

control_name: Billing to the approved price list
control_objective: Every invoice is raised from the price list approved for that contract

control_name: Cash application within two business days
control_objective: A receipt is applied to the paying customer within two business days

control_name: Approval of receivable write offs
control_objective: A receivable is written off only with approval at the delegated level

control_name: Aging agreed to the control account
control_objective: The receivable aging agrees to the ledger control account every period

control_name: Purchase order approval before commitment
control_objective: No commitment reaches a supplier before the order is approved in its band

control_name: Three way match before payment
control_objective: An invoice is paid only where it matches its order and its receipt

control_name: Vendor master change applied by a second person
control_objective: The person who requests a vendor master change never applies it

control_name: Duplicate invoice number blocked at entry
control_objective: An invoice number already held for that supplier cannot be entered again

control_name: Accrual for goods and services received not invoiced
control_objective: Goods and services received before period end are accrued in that period

control_name: Call back on a vendor bank detail change
control_objective: A change to supplier bank details is confirmed by call back to a known contact

control_name: Preparer and approver of an entry are different people
control_objective: No person both prepares and approves the same journal entry

control_name: Supporting evidence attached to every entry
control_objective: Every entry in the close batch carries the document that supports it

control_name: Balance sheet reconciliations prepared and reviewed
control_objective: Every balance sheet account is reconciled and reviewed before the close is approved

control_name: Bank reconciliation within three business days of period end
control_objective: The operating account is reconciled to the cash ledger within three business days

control_name: Period locked once the close is approved
control_objective: The period is closed to new postings as soon as the close is approved

control_name: Written explanation for a manual adjustment above the threshold
control_objective: A manual adjustment above the reporting threshold carries a written explanation

control_name: Quarterly review of the finance system access list
control_objective: Finance system access is compared against current roles every quarter

control_name: Approval before finance system access is granted
control_objective: New access to a finance system is approved by its owner before it is granted

control_name: Posting access restricted to named administrators
control_objective: The right to post journal entries is held only by named administrators

control_name: Recorded approval before finance data leaves the approved environment
control_objective: Finance data reaches an outside processor only with recorded approval

control_name: Dual approval before a payment run is released
control_objective: A payment run reaches the bank only after two approvals are recorded

control_name: Payment only to bank details held on the vendor master
control_objective: A payment is made only to the bank details held on the approved vendor master

control_name: Review and void of stale outstanding checks
control_objective: A check outstanding past the stale date is reviewed and voided

control_name: Bank signatories confirmed against the authority schedule
control_objective: The bank signatory list agrees to the delegated authority schedule

control_name: Weekly cash position reporting
control_objective: The cash position is reported to the treasury owner every week
